states.caption: Level cleared: the screen closes on the hero, the banner drops in (loops). Shot: mid-close.

a.name: Iris
a.note: A circle closes on the hero, then STAGE CLEAR.

c.name: Pixel dissolve
c.note: The screen breaks into blocks that fill in.

recommend.why: The iris ends on the hero, so the player sees who they're cheering for; the wipe hides them first.
